# asc_vpc (Data Source)

Reads a VPC managed by ASC infra-gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_vpc" "platform" {
  name = "platform"
}

output "platform_subnet_cidrs" {
  value = [for subnet in data.asc_vpc.platform.subnets : subnet.cidr]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VPC to read.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block of the VPC.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the VPC.
- `last_error` (String) Last error reported for the VPC, empty when healthy.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by infra-gateway.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets belonging to the VPC, in the order infra-gateway reports them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the VPC.
- `urn` (String) URN of the VPC.

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block of the subnet.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the subnet.
- `last_error` (String) Last error reported for the subnet, empty when healthy.
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the subnet.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the subnet.
- `type` (String) Subnet type, public or private.
- `urn` (String) URN of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (String) Identifier of the owning VPC.
